notes.scope: Draft track catalog and crate configuration copied from game_tracks.csv; the CSV remains the current application source. track_catalog_fields preserve CSV values as strings.
notes.probability: Final per-lootbox probabilities sum to 1 for each Time Trial tier and Ring Rally lap count. Probabilities were derived by flattening the earlier reference weights and normalizing to 0.01 percentage points, so rare crates remain rarer while avoiding very long waits. At least 10% for each of 20 mutually exclusive types is impossible.
notes.quantity: On selection, grant a uniformly random integer between min_quantity and max_quantity inclusive. Compared with the earlier pre-calibration draft, Time Trial and Ring Rally quantities are twice as large.
notes.performance_tiers: Time Trial: strict time comparisons; dev beaten takes priority, otherwise velo beaten, otherwise neither. Ring Rally: no rewards below 5 laps, one to three lootboxes by non-overlapping lap category; probabilities use the exact lap table, capped above maximum. Quantities interpolate linearly between endpoint values, rounding maximum down.
notes.requirements: Each track with Ring Rally requires five selected types; mod tracks have no Ring Rally bonus or unlock requirements. Infinity is exchanged independently.
notes.wildcard: Infinity can be exchanged independently of unlocking a bonus. Rates define exact integer quantities; target inventory and source track scope remain undecided.
notes.reward: The bonus is additive and applies to Ring Rally on this track only; activation timing is undecided.
notes.rarity: Higher rarity values indicate more common crates. Baseline probability proposal: 0.01 + 0.59 * (rarity / 99)^1.5; modifiers and limits are recorded per crate.
notes.missing_reference: When a reference time is unavailable, tier selection requires an explicit decision before implementation; do not assume it was beaten.
notes.lap_categories: Categories partition the inclusive interval from 5 to the track maximum as evenly as possible. The final category has no upper bound; its rewards stop increasing at reward_cap_laps. Categories do not modify probabilities.
notes.requirement_balance: Proposed thresholds use the previous rarity-based thresholds, increased by 50% and rounded up for rarity above 50. Values are per track and remain editable.

time_trial.selection: dev_beaten first; otherwise velo_only if velo beaten; otherwise neither

lootbox_model.description: After a race, each reward box selects one crate type and grants a quantity of that type. Multiple boxes may give different crate types.
lootbox_model.selection_probability_conversion: Previously drafted reference weights were flattened, normalized, rounded to 0.01 percentage points and stored per Time Trial tier and per Ring Rally lap.
lootbox_model.quantity_source: selected crate type and race mode reward rule
